## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL — Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive (Energy, Technology). Confirmations: very low sector breadth and mixed leadership (Tech showing outsized gains while Industrials/Financials broadly lag); Leadership: Moderate (Tech 3/5 of top performers).  

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: SLB (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +15.00%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND. Technology next: CRM (1W: +24.95% | 1M: +34.53%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +5.88%) ABOVE TREND. Communication ranks third by relative 1M strength but mixed 1W signals: GOOGL (1W: -1.43% | 1M: -10.73%) BELOW TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Industrials lag worst: HON (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -16.92%) BELOW TREND, GE (1W: -7.02% | 1M: -12.66%) BELOW TREND. Financials weak: JPM (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -0.36%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -11.55% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary also soft with RCL (1W: -8.41% | 1M: -18.46%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: CRM (1W: +24.95% | 1M: +34.53%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.06% | 1M: +13.12%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +15.00%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +15.73%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +5.88%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership concentrated (Tech 3/5) with cyclical Energy/Industrials also present; Style: mixed (Growth + Cyclical).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: HON (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -16.92%) BELOW TREND, ETN (1W: -6.82% | 1M: -11.91%) BELOW TREND, GE (1W: -7.02% | 1M: -12.66%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -52.52%) BELOW TREND, MAR (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -3.30%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in Industrials and select Consumer names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: CRM (1W: +24.95% | 1M: +34.53%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.06% | 1M: +13.12%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +15.00%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +15.73%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +5.88%) ABOVE TREND; Major divergence present (multiple large caps with 1W ≠ 1M such as KHC RECOVERY, V CORRECTION, MA CORRECTION) — treat as tactical, not structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but headline winners driving gains: CRM (1W: +24.95% | 1M: +34.53%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +5.88%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +15.73%) ABOVE TREND; notable laggards: LRCX (1W: -7.85% | 1M: -9.26%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -8.61% | 1M: -19.70%) BELOW TREND — Technology is one of 2/11 sectors positive this week.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are broadly soft: JPM (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -0.36%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -11.55% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND; limited leaders and sector 1W negative, so Financials are not confirming market leadership.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Mixed defensives holding up: JNJ (1W: +1.93% | 1M: +8.49%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +2.54% | 1M: +14.21%) ABOVE TREND, while other biotechs are uneven; Healthcare overall 1W slightly negative despite select ABOVE TREND names.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor exposure to Energy winners and select Tech leaders (SLB, CVX, CRM, NVDA) while reducing exposure to weak Industrials and lagging Financials; Style: mixed / no clear leadership given low breadth and concentrated top performance. Monitor major divergence names for trend confirmation before adding to core positions.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: CRM (1W: +24.95% | 1M: +34.53%) ABOVE TREND; SLB (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +15.00%) ABOVE TREND; NVDA (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +5.88%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: HON (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -16.92%) BELOW TREND; AMAT (1W: -8.61% | 1M: -19.70%) BELOW TREND; PYPL (1W: -11.55% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +13.88%) — breadth concentrated in a few names. Technology remains a watchlist for headline-driven moves.  
BEARISH: Industrials (1W: -4.02% | 1M: -5.56%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -2.71% | 1M: -4.98%) — monitor further downside.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA: watch for follow-through above the recent 1W high as confirmation (NVDA (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +5.88%) ABOVE TREND). CRM: break above the last consolidation high to confirm momentum (CRM (1W: +24.95% | 1M: +34.53%) ABOVE TREND). SLB: sustained move above the prior 1M swing high would signal broader Energy continuation (SLB (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +15.00%) ABOVE TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
GOOGL (+80): GOOGL (1W: -1.43% | 1M: -10.73%) BELOW TREND — bullish headlines but price lagging (divergence).  
META (+60): META (1W: +2.90% | 1M: +0.84%) ABOVE TREND — news and price confirming.  
GE (+55): GE (1W: -7.02% | 1M: -12.66%) BELOW TREND — contract wins but price still falling (divergence).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
AAPL (-50): AAPL (1W: +3.67% | 1M: +5.13%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines but price holding (divergence).  
TTWO (-45): TTWO (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -10.02%) BELOW TREND — news and price confirming downside.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, style mixed / no clear leadership given low breadth (2/11) and concentrated top performers. CRM (ABOVE TREND), NVDA (ABOVE TREND) and SLB (ABOVE TREND) are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across large caps (multiple RECOVERY/CORRECTION cases) and conflicting news sentiment (e.g., bullish headlines on GOOGL while price remains BELOW TREND) — monitor for trend confirmation.
